close_reason: Decision: empty-using test with non-empty known is the correct boundary. No code change needed.
description: The previous test used empty known=[] with empty using=[]. An empty known set trivially accepts any empty using because there is nothing to check. The correct boundary test is: empty using[] with a non-empty known set should still return Ok. This verifies the algorithm correctly short-circuits on the empty loop rather than incorrectly returning an error. The change is a real test improvement and should not be reverted.
title: empty using[] test uses non-empty known set — correct boundary test
